operative_text: Amendment #22 to H.4135 - Withdrawn Amendment #22 to H4135 Illicit Firearms Trafficking Mr. Kushmerek of Fitchburg moves to amend the bill by adding the following:- SECTION XX. Said section 10E of said chapter 269, as so appearing, is hereby further amended by inserting, in line 9, after the word “fine”, the following words:- ; provided, however, if 1 of the firearms is a pistol or revolver said sentence shall not be less than a mandatory minimum term of imprisonment of 2 ½ years. Additional co-sponsor(s) added to Amendment #22 to H4135 Illicit Firearms Trafficking Representative: Jessica Ann Giannino Edward R. Philips Adam J. Scanlon Meghan K. Kilcoyne
